Figures and tables for the manuscript (`Manuscripts/T2D_AD_MR/`). This notebook recomputes no MR
estimates. It reads only committed CSVs, so every number traces to a commit.

**Conventions**

- **Chunk labels name content, not figure numbers.** Each figure is written to
  `figures/ms-<chunk label>-1.pdf` / `.png`, and figure numbers are assigned only in
  `Manuscripts/T2D_AD_MR/README.md`. Reordering figures, or reformatting for a journal, changes the
  README, not the files.
- **Source data.** Each figure chunk writes the data it plots to
  `results/manuscript/source_data/<chunk label>.csv`; panels within a chunk get a suffix.
- **Tables.** Written to `results/manuscript/tables/<name>.csv`.
- **Provenance.** The table in the next section is rebuilt on every render and saved as
  `results/manuscript/provenance.csv`. It records each input file, what produced it, the last commit
  that changed it, and whether it has uncommitted changes. For submission, render with
  `quarto render manuscript_figures.qmd -P strict:true`.

Derived from `t2d_ad_figures.qmd`, the colour, large-font version for talks. The estimators, filters
and in-notebook calculations are the same, so the numbers match. These figures are greyscale for
print: series are told apart by shape and line type, not colour. Three figures also add what the talk
version left out (see the notes under each figure).

## Inputs and provenance

```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(knitr)

res_dir <- "results/pipeline"
con_dir <- file.path(res_dir, "contrast")
ms_dir  <- "results/manuscript"
src_dir <- file.path(ms_dir, "source_data")
tab_dir <- file.path(ms_dir, "tables")
for (d in c(src_dir, tab_dir)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Every file this notebook reads, and what wrote it. Pipeline history: results/pipeline/RUN_INFO.md.
inputs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~file,                                              ~produced_by,
  "pipeline/config.yml",                              "hand-edited pipeline settings; dataset definitions (data-sources table)",
  "results/pipeline/results.csv",                     "_targets.R `csv_results`; b_SH uncertainty added by pipeline/bsh_propagate_existing.R (7d9cad5)",
  "results/pipeline/instruments_classical.csv",       "_targets.R `csv_instruments_classical`",
  "ad_longevity_arm.csv",                             "exposure_survival_screen.qmd (Step 1 screen, OpenGWAS API)",
  "results/pipeline/contrast/results.csv",            "_targets.R `csv_contrast_results`; b_SH propagation (7d9cad5)",
  "results/pipeline/contrast/cluster_results.csv",    "_targets.R `csv_contrast_groups`; b_SH propagation (7d9cad5)",
  "results/pipeline/contrast/drug_target_results.csv","_targets.R `csv_cis_results`; b_SH propagation (7d9cad5)",
  "results/pipeline/contrast/instrument_outcome_data.csv", "_targets.R `csv_contrast_data`",
  "results/pipeline/contrast/step0_strength.csv",     "_targets.R `csv_contrast_strength` (outcome-blind Step 0, 38987ad)",
  "results/pipeline/contrast/xue_cluster_map.csv",    "_targets.R `csv_xue_cluster_map` (post-freeze LD map, 6814fd5)")

git <- function(...) suppressWarnings(tryCatch(system2("git", c(...), stdout = TRUE, stderr = FALSE),
                                               error = \(e) character()))
git_last <- function(f) {
  x <- git("log", "-1", shQuote("--format=%h %ad"), "--date=short", "--", shQuote(f))
  if (length(x)) x else "NOT COMMITTED"
}
git_dirty <- function(f) length(git("status", "--porcelain", "--", shQuote(f))) > 0
# Pipeline stamp (pipeline/R/provenance.R), if the file has one: step, commit, and whether the stamped
# md5 still matches the file. Files without one predate stamping (see results/pipeline/RUN_INFO.md).
stamp_of <- function(f) {
  s <- file.path(dirname(f), "stamps", paste0(basename(f), ".txt"))
  if (!file.exists(s)) return("none (see RUN_INFO.md)")
  kv <- sub("^[a-z_]+: ", "", setNames(readLines(s), sub(":.*", "", readLines(s))))
  sprintf("%s @ %s%s", kv[["step"]], kv[["git_commit"]],
          if (kv[["md5"]] == unname(tools::md5sum(f))) "" else " (FILE CHANGED SINCE STAMP)")
}

stopifnot("an input file is missing" = all(file.exists(inputs$file)))
provenance <- inputs |>
  mutate(md5         = substr(unname(tools::md5sum(file)), 1, 10),
         last_commit = unname(vapply(file, git_last, "")),
         uncommitted = unname(vapply(file, git_dirty, TRUE)),
         stamp       = unname(vapply(file, stamp_of, "")))
head_commit <- git("rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD")

if (any(provenance$uncommitted | provenance$last_commit == "NOT COMMITTED")) {
  msg <- paste("Inputs with uncommitted changes:",
               paste(provenance$file[provenance$uncommitted], collapse = ", "))
  if (isTRUE(params$strict)) stop(msg) else warning(msg)
}
write_csv(provenance |> mutate(rendered = as.character(Sys.Date()), rendered_at_commit = head_commit),
          file.path(ms_dir, "provenance.csv"))
kable(provenance, caption = sprintf("Rendered at commit %s.", head_commit))
```

```{r helpers}
# ---- read inputs (guess_max = Inf: the b_SH columns are NA for most rows and would be mis-typed) ----
rd  <- \(f) read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE, guess_max = Inf, name_repair = "unique_quiet")
res    <- rd(file.path(res_dir, "results.csv"))
inst   <- rd(file.path(res_dir, "instruments_classical.csv"))
con    <- rd(file.path(con_dir, "results.csv"))
con_cl <- rd(file.path(con_dir, "cluster_results.csv"))
con_dt <- rd(file.path(con_dir, "drug_target_results.csv"))
iod    <- rd(file.path(con_dir, "instrument_outcome_data.csv"))
step0  <- rd(file.path(con_dir, "step0_strength.csv"))
cfg    <- yaml::read_yaml("pipeline/config.yml")

# ---- settings: edit here -------------------------------------------------------------------
ad_outcome     <- "ad_bellenguez"                                 # pre-specified primary outcome
short <- c(bmi_ukb = "BMI", fatmass_ukb = "Fat mass", leanmass_pei = "Lean mass",
           ffm_ukb = "Fat-free mass", t2d_xue = "Type 2 diabetes",
           fg_dupuis = "Fasting glucose", glu2h_chen = "2 h glucose")
body_exposures <- c("t2d_xue", "bmi_ukb", "leanmass_pei")
glyc_exposures <- c("t2d_xue", "fg_dupuis", "glu2h_chen")
uv_methods <- c("IVW-MRE" = "IVW", "MRBEE" = "MRBEE", "Weighted median" = "Weighted median")
arm_labels <- c(raw = "Uncorrected", slopehunter = "SlopeHunter-corrected")
# AD outcomes for the fasting vs 2 h glucose, cluster and drug-target analyses (config `contrast: outcomes`)
con_outcomes <- tibble::tribble(
  ~outcome,            ~arm,          ~dataset,
  "ad_bellenguez",     "slopehunter", "Bellenguez 2022, SlopeHunter-corrected (primary)",
  "ad_kunkle",         "raw",         "Kunkle 2019, clinical",
  "ad_uffelmann_newc", "raw",         "Uffelmann 2026, new cohorts (replication)",
  "ad_uffelmann_cc",   "raw",         "Uffelmann 2026, clinical only")
rep_outcomes <- con_outcomes[c(1, 3), ]                           # primary + independent replication
comb_out <- "ad_uffelmann_all"; comb_arm <- "raw"
comb_lab <- "Uffelmann 2026, all cohorts (overlaps Bellenguez; uncorrected)"
con_methods <- c("IVW-MRE" = "IVW", "MRBEE" = "MRBEE")
set_labels  <- c(primary = "Suzuki 2024 instruments (pre-specified primary set)",
                 xue     = "Xue 2018 instruments (sensitivity set)")

# ---- palette (print-safe; maize darkened from the talk version) ---------------------------
# Greyscale for print: series are told apart by shape (and line type) as well as grey level, so
# the figures survive black-and-white printing. The colour versions for talks are in t2d_ad_figures.qmd.
ink <- "black"; dark <- "grey35"; mid <- "grey60"
method_cols  <- setNames(c(ink, dark, mid), uv_methods)
method_lty   <- setNames(c("solid", "dashed", "dotted"), uv_methods)
arm_cols     <- setNames(c(mid, ink), arm_labels)
arm_shapes   <- setNames(c(1, 16), arm_labels)                  # open = uncorrected, filled = corrected
con_cols     <- setNames(c(mid, ink), con_methods)
con_shapes   <- setNames(c(1, 16), con_methods)                 # open = IVW, filled = MRBEE
rep_cols     <- setNames(c(ink, mid), rep_outcomes$dataset)
rep_shapes   <- setNames(c(16, 17), rep_outcomes$dataset)       # circle = primary, triangle = replication
glu_cols     <- c(AD = ink, `Fasting glucose` = mid, `2 h glucose` = ink)
glu_shapes   <- c(AD = 16, `Fasting glucose` = 1, `2 h glucose` = 17)

theme_ms <- theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, colour = "grey30"))

# ---- output helpers ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plotted data -> results/manuscript/source_data/<chunk label>[-suffix].csv
save_source <- function(d, suffix = NULL) {
  lab <- paste(c(knitr::opts_current$get("label"), suffix), collapse = "-")
  write_csv(d, file.path(src_dir, paste0(lab, ".csv")))
  invisible(d)
}
save_table <- function(d, name, caption = NULL) {
  write_csv(d, file.path(tab_dir, paste0(name, ".csv")))
  kable(d, caption = caption)
}
or_ci <- \(b, lo, hi) sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", exp(b), exp(lo), exp(hi))

uv_rows <- function(exposures, out, arms = c("raw", "slopehunter")) {
  res |>
    filter(exposure %in% exposures, outcome == out, arm %in% arms, method %in% names(uv_methods)) |>
    mutate(method_label   = factor(uv_methods[method], levels = uv_methods),
           arm_label      = factor(arm_labels[arm], levels = arm_labels),
           exposure_label = factor(short[exposure], levels = rev(short[exposures])))
}
forest_or <- function(dat, xlim, xlab = "Odds ratio for AD per unit higher exposure (95% CI)") {
  ggplot(dat, aes(x = exp(b), xmin = exp(ci_lo), xmax = exp(ci_hi), y = exposure_label,
                  colour = arm_label, shape = arm_label)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
    geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 0.35) +
    facet_wrap(~ method_label, nrow = 1) +
    scale_x_log10(limits = xlim) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = arm_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = arm_shapes, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = NULL, colour = NULL, shape = NULL) +
    theme_ms
}
rep_forest <- function(d, xlab, caption = NULL) {
  ggplot(d, aes(x = exp(b), xmin = exp(b - 1.96 * se), xmax = exp(b + 1.96 * se), y = label,
                colour = dataset, shape = dataset)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
    geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(width = -0.6), size = 0.3) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_colour_manual(values = rep_cols, breaks = rep_outcomes$dataset) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = rep_shapes, breaks = rep_outcomes$dataset) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = NULL, colour = NULL, shape = NULL, caption = caption) +
    theme_ms
}
```

## Data sources

Built from `pipeline/config.yml` → `datasets:`, the single place each GWAS is defined. Entries marked
"TO CONFIRM" in the config are listed under [Open items](#open-items).

```{r table-data-sources}
`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x
role_of <- function(k) case_when(grepl("^ad_", k) ~ "Outcome: Alzheimer's disease",
                                 k == "lifespan" ~ "Selection axis (survival)",
                                 k %in% c("bmi_ukb", "fatmass_ukb", "ffm_ukb", "leanmass_pei") ~ "Exposure: body composition",
                                 TRUE ~ "Exposure: glycemic")
data_sources <- purrr::imap_dfr(cfg$datasets, \(d, k) tibble(
  key = k, Role = role_of(k), Dataset = d$label, Accession = d$id,
  `Obtained from` = c(opengwas_vcf = "OpenGWAS VCF", local_tsv = "local file", chrpos_tsv = "local file")[d$source],
  N = d$sample_size %||% NA_real_, Type = d$type,
  Cohorts = paste(d$cohorts, collapse = ", "), `Adjusted for` = d$adjusted_for %||% "none")) |>
  arrange(Role, key)
save_table(data_sources, "data_sources")
```

## Survival bias and its correction

### Both arms of the collider

Survival is a collider only if both the exposure and AD liability affect it. IVW only: the AD →
lifespan arm comes from the Step 1 screen (`ad_longevity_arm.csv`), which has standard errors for IVW
alone. Units differ by row, so read direction and whether the interval excludes zero.

```{r survival-collider, fig.width=6, fig.height=3.2}
ad_life <- read_csv("ad_longevity_arm.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(grepl("Bellenguez", exposure), grepl("Martingale", survival)) |>
  transmute(label = "AD liability", arm = "Outcome arm", b, ci_lo = b - 1.96 * se, ci_hi = b + 1.96 * se, p, n_snp)
survival <- res |>
  filter(exposure %in% body_exposures, outcome == "lifespan", method == "IVW-MRE") |>
  transmute(label = short[exposure], arm = "Exposure arm", b, ci_lo, ci_hi, p, n_snp) |>
  bind_rows(ad_life) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = rev(c("AD liability", short[c("bmi_ukb", "t2d_xue", "leanmass_pei")]))),
         arm = factor(arm, levels = c("Outcome arm", "Exposure arm")))
save_source(survival)

ggplot(survival, aes(x = b, xmin = ci_lo, xmax = ci_hi, y = label, colour = arm)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_pointrange(size = 0.4) +
  facet_grid(arm ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Outcome arm" = ink, "Exposure arm" = dark), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Effect on parental lifespan, IVW (95% CI); positive = shorter life", y = NULL) +
  theme_ms + theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))
```

## Fasting vs 2 h glucose

**Pre-specification.** The rule was fixed at Step 0, before any AD data were read: if the
conditional F for 2 h glucose is at least 10, MVMR is primary; otherwise the contrast regression (by
MRBEE) is primary, and MVMR is reported as underpowered. Conditional F was below 10 in every set
(`step0_strength.csv`), so **the pre-specified primary estimate is the contrast regression on the
Suzuki set**. The talk version plotted only MVMR on the Xue set. This figure shows both analyses on
both sets, labelled. Scale: per mmol/L, which does not depend on the unconfirmed `sd_mmol`
constants. Per-SD estimates are in the table.

- MVMR: $\hat\beta_{AD} = \theta_F\hat\beta_F + \theta_2\hat\beta_2$. The difference row is
  $\theta_2 - \theta_F$, with the full covariance.
- Contrast regression: $\hat\beta_{AD} = a(\hat\beta_2 - \hat\beta_F) + c\,\hat\beta_{T2D}$. $a > 0$
  means the AD signal follows post-load-specific physiology (`pipeline/R/contrast_outcome.R`).

```{r fg-2h, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
term_labels <- c(fg = "Fasting glucose | 2 h", glu2h = "2 h glucose | fasting",
                 `glu2h - fg` = "Difference, 2 h - fasting", contrast = "Contrast (2 h - fasting) | T2D")
step_labels <- c(`1 MVMR` = "MVMR", `2 contrast regression` = "Contrast regression\n(pre-specified primary)")
fg2h <- con |>
  filter(outcome == ad_outcome, arm == "slopehunter", set %in% names(set_labels), scale == "per mmol/L",
         estimator %in% names(con_methods), term %in% names(term_labels)) |>
  mutate(ci_lo = b - 1.96 * se, ci_hi = b + 1.96 * se,
         set_label    = factor(set_labels[set], levels = set_labels),
         step_label   = factor(step_labels[step], levels = step_labels),
         term_label   = factor(term_labels[term], levels = rev(term_labels)),
         method_label = factor(con_methods[estimator], levels = con_methods))
save_source(fg2h |> select(set, outcome, arm, step, estimator, term, scale, b, se, ci_lo, ci_hi, p, n_snp))

ggplot(fg2h, aes(x = exp(b), xmin = exp(ci_lo), xmax = exp(ci_hi), y = term_label,
                 colour = method_label, shape = method_label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 0.35) +
  facet_grid(step_label ~ set_label, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y",
             labeller = labeller(set_label = label_wrap_gen(30))) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.7, 0.85, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 1.75)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = con_cols) + scale_shape_manual(values = con_shapes) +
  labs(x = "Odds ratio for AD per mmol/L (95% CI); difference row: ratio of odds ratios", y = NULL,
       colour = NULL, shape = NULL,
       caption = "AD: Bellenguez 2022, SlopeHunter-corrected. Glucose effects: Chen 2021 (BMI-adjusted).") +
  theme_ms + theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))
```

```{r table-fg-2h}

  filter(set %in% names(set_labels), estimator %in% names(con_methods), term %in% names(term_labels)) |>
```

### Validation: separability and the added-variable plot

For each instrument set: left, each variant's fasting vs 2 h glucose effect (identification needs the
mix to vary); right, the Frisch–Waugh–Lovell added-variable plot, whose slope is exactly the IVW
estimate of $\theta_2$.

```{r fg-2h-validation, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
validation_panels <- function(s) {
  val <- iod |> filter(set == s, outcome == ad_outcome, arm == "slopehunter") |> mutate(w = 1 / se_y^2)
  st  <- step0 |> filter(set == s)
  val <- val |> mutate(resid_y  = resid(lm(beta_y ~ 0 + beta_fg, weights = w)),
                       resid_2h = resid(lm(beta_2h ~ 0 + beta_fg, weights = w)))
  fwl <- coef(lm(resid_y ~ 0 + resid_2h, data = val, weights = w))[[1]]
  mv  <- coef(lm(beta_y ~ 0 + beta_fg + beta_2h, data = val, weights = w))[["beta_2h"]]
  stopifnot(abs(fwl - mv) < 1e-10)   # the added-variable slope IS the MVMR IVW estimate
  mrbee <- fg2h |> filter(set == s, step == "1 MVMR", estimator == "MRBEE", term == "glu2h") |> pull(b)
  save_source(val |> select(set, SNP, beta_fg, se_fg, beta_2h, se_2h, beta_y, se_y, w, resid_2h, resid_y), s)

  p1 <- ggplot(val, aes(beta_fg, beta_2h)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = beta_2h - 1.96 * se_2h, ymax = beta_2h + 1.96 * se_2h), colour = "grey80", width = 0) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = beta_fg - 1.96 * se_fg, xmax = beta_fg + 1.96 * se_fg), colour = "grey80",
                  width = 0, orientation = "y") +
    geom_point(colour = ink, size = 1) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.02, vjust = -0.3, size = 2.8, lineheight = 0.95,
             label = sprintf("r = %.2f\nConditional F, 2 h | fasting = %.1f\nConditional F, fasting | 2 h = %.1f",
                             cor(val$beta_fg, val$beta_2h), st$cond_F_2h, st$cond_F_fg)) +
    labs(x = "Effect on fasting glucose (mmol/L)", y = "Effect on 2 h glucose (mmol/L)",
         subtitle = set_labels[[s]]) +
    theme_ms + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line())
  p2 <- ggplot(val, aes(resid_2h, resid_y)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") +
    geom_point(aes(size = w), colour = ink, alpha = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_abline(aes(slope = fwl, intercept = 0, colour = "IVW"), linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_abline(aes(slope = mrbee, intercept = 0, colour = "MRBEE"), linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 2.5) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(IVW = mid, MRBEE = ink),
                        labels = c(IVW = sprintf("IVW = %.3f", fwl), MRBEE = sprintf("MRBEE = %.3f", mrbee))) +
    labs(x = "2 h glucose effect beyond fasting (mmol/L)", y = "AD effect beyond fasting (log-OR)", colour = NULL) +
    theme_ms + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line())
  p1 + p2
}
validation_panels("primary") / validation_panels("xue") + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
```

## T2D liability → AD by mechanistic cluster

Suzuki 2024 instruments split by the paper's clusters (frozen before any AD data were read). Left:
AD per unit log-odds of T2D carried by the cluster. Right: the same variants' effect on fasting and 2
h glucose. The glucose slopes are computed here from `instrument_outcome_data.csv`: IVW through the
origin on the T2D effect, residual scale floored at 1, as in the pipeline's `wls_mre()`. The
liver/lipid cluster (2 variants) and "other (small)" are in the table only.

```{r clusters, fig.width=8, fig.height=4.5}
beta_levels <- c("All beta cell", "Beta cell -PI", "Beta cell +PI")
cl_pick <- function(d) d |>
  filter(set == "primary",
         model == "T2D effect x cluster" | (model == "T2D effect x beta-cell" & grepl("^Beta", group))) |>
  mutate(group = if_else(model == "T2D effect x beta-cell", "All beta cell", group))
cl <- cl_pick(con_cl) |>
  filter(outcome == ad_outcome, arm == "slopehunter") |>
  mutate(ci_lo = b - 1.96 * se, ci_hi = b + 1.96 * se,
         kind = if_else(group %in% beta_levels, "Beta-cell clusters", "Other clusters")) |>
  arrange(kind != "Beta-cell clusters", match(group, beta_levels), desc(b)) |>
  mutate(label = sprintf("%s (%d)", group, n_snp), label = factor(label, levels = rev(label)))
cl_het <- con_cl |>
  filter(set == "primary", outcome == ad_outcome, arm == "slopehunter", model == "T2D effect x cluster") |>
  distinct(het_Q, het_df, het_p)

ivw_slope <- function(y, se, x) {
  f <- summary(lm(y ~ 0 + x, weights = 1 / se^2))
  tibble(b = f$coefficients[1, 1], se = f$coefficients[1, 2] / f$sigma * max(1, f$sigma))
}
con_snps <- iod |> filter(set == "primary", outcome == ad_outcome, arm == "slopehunter")
cl_glu <- bind_rows(con_snps, con_snps |> filter(grepl("^Beta cell", cluster)) |> mutate(cluster = "All beta cell")) |>
  group_by(group = cluster) |>
  reframe(bind_rows(`Fasting glucose` = ivw_slope(beta_fg, se_fg, beta_t2d),
                    `2 h glucose` = ivw_slope(beta_2h, se_2h, beta_t2d), .id = "series")) |>
  mutate(ci_lo = b - 1.96 * se, ci_hi = b + 1.96 * se)
cl_both <- cl |>
  transmute(group, series = "AD", b = exp(b), ci_lo = exp(ci_lo), ci_hi = exp(ci_hi), panel = "AD risk") |>
  bind_rows(cl_glu |> mutate(panel = "Glucose") |> select(group, series, b, ci_lo, ci_hi, panel)) |>
  inner_join(cl |> select(group, label, kind), by = "group") |>
  filter(!group %in% c("other (small)", "Liver/lipid metabolism")) |>
  mutate(panel = factor(panel, levels = c("AD risk", "Glucose")))
save_source(cl_both)

ggplot(cl_both, aes(x = b, xmin = ci_lo, xmax = ci_hi, y = label, colour = series, shape = series)) +
  geom_vline(data = data.frame(panel = factor(c("AD risk", "Glucose"), levels = c("AD risk", "Glucose")), x = c(1, 0)),
             aes(xintercept = x), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 0.3) +
  facet_grid(kind ~ panel, scales = "free", space = "free_y",
             labeller = labeller(panel = c(`AD risk` = "Odds ratio for AD (95% CI)",
                                           Glucose = "Glucose, mmol/L (95% CI)"))) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = glu_cols, breaks = c("Fasting glucose", "2 h glucose")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = glu_shapes, breaks = c("Fasting glucose", "2 h glucose")) +
  labs(x = "Per unit higher log-odds of T2D carried by the cluster", y = NULL, colour = NULL, shape = NULL,
       caption = sprintf("Variants per cluster in brackets. AD: Bellenguez, SlopeHunter-corrected. Heterogeneity across clusters: Q = %.1f, df = %d, p = %.2f.",
                         cl_het$het_Q, cl_het$het_df, cl_het$het_p)) +
  theme_ms + theme(strip.text.y = element_blank())
```

```{r clusters-replication, fig.width=7, fig.height=4.5}
cl_rep <- cl_pick(con_cl) |>
  inner_join(rep_outcomes, by = c("outcome", "arm")) |>
  filter(!group %in% c("other (small)", "Liver/lipid metabolism")) |>
  mutate(label = factor(group, levels = rev(unique(cl$group))), dataset = factor(dataset, levels = rep_outcomes$dataset))
save_source(cl_rep |> select(set, outcome, arm, model, group, b, se, p, n_snp))
rep_forest(cl_rep, "Odds ratio for AD per unit higher log-odds of T2D (95% CI)", "Suzuki 2024 clusters (frozen assignments).")
```

```{r table-clusters}
  inner_join(bind_rows(con_outcomes, tibble(outcome = comb_out, arm = comb_arm, dataset = comb_lab)),
             by = c("outcome", "arm")) |>
  transmute(Cluster = group, `AD dataset` = dataset, SNPs = n_snp, b, se,

write_csv(cl_tab, file.path(tab_dir, "cluster_results.csv"))
cl_glu |>

  pivot_wider(names_from = series, values_from = est) |>

             by = "Cluster") |>
```

## From T2D liability to the KATP channel (post hoc)

**Post hoc.** The KATP channel was singled out because it stood out among nine drug classes, so its
estimate is probably inflated by that selection. The steps overlap, so they are not independent. Xue
2018 instruments; the beta-cell step uses the post-freeze LD map onto Suzuki clusters
(`xue_cluster_map.csv`). Step 4 is a single-variant ratio (rs5215).

```{r katp-specificity, fig.width=7, fig.height=3.2}
spec_set <- "xue"
snp_data <- iod |>
  filter(set == spec_set) |>
  select(-any_of("cluster")) |>
  left_join(rd(file.path(con_dir, "xue_cluster_map.csv")) |> select(SNP, cluster), by = "SNP")
rho_fg2h <- step0 |> filter(set == spec_set) |> pull(error_cor_fg_2h)
two_h_specific <- function(x) {
  delta <- coef(lm(beta_2h ~ 0 + beta_fg, data = x, weights = 1 / se_2h^2))[[1]]
  x |> mutate(z_2h_spec = (beta_2h - delta * beta_fg) /
                sqrt(se_2h^2 + delta^2 * se_fg^2 - 2 * delta * rho_fg2h * se_2h * se_fg))
}
ivw_t2d <- function(x) {
  f <- summary(lm(beta_y ~ 0 + beta_t2d, data = x, weights = 1 / se_y^2))
  tibble(b = f$coefficients[1, 1], se = f$coefficients[1, 2] / f$sigma * max(1, f$sigma), n_snp = nrow(x))
}
wald <- function(x) tibble(b = x$beta_y / x$beta_t2d, se = x$se_y / x$beta_t2d, n_snp = 1L)
spec_steps <- c("All T2D variants", "2 h glucose beyond fasting", "Beta-cell clusters", "KATP channel (rs5215)")
spec_one <- function(x) bind_rows(
  ivw_t2d(x) |> mutate(step = spec_steps[1]),
  ivw_t2d(filter(two_h_specific(x), z_2h_spec > 1.96)) |> mutate(step = spec_steps[2]),
  ivw_t2d(filter(x, grepl("^Beta cell", cluster))) |> mutate(step = spec_steps[3]),
  wald(filter(x, SNP == "rs5215")) |> mutate(step = spec_steps[4]))
spec <- bind_rows(con_outcomes, tibble(outcome = comb_out, arm = comb_arm, dataset = comb_lab)) |>
  purrr::pmap_dfr(\(outcome, arm, dataset)
    spec_one(snp_data |> filter(.data$outcome == !!outcome, .data$arm == !!arm)) |>
      mutate(outcome = outcome, arm = arm, dataset = dataset)) |>
  mutate(ci_lo = b - 1.96 * se, ci_hi = b + 1.96 * se, p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(b / se)),
         step = factor(step, levels = spec_steps))
spec_plot <- spec |>
  inner_join(rep_outcomes |> select(outcome, arm), by = c("outcome", "arm")) |>
  mutate(label = factor(step, levels = rev(spec_steps)), dataset = factor(dataset, levels = rep_outcomes$dataset))
save_source(spec_plot |> select(outcome, arm, dataset, step, b, se, ci_lo, ci_hi, p, n_snp))
rep_forest(spec_plot, "Odds ratio for AD per unit higher log-odds of T2D (95% CI)",
           "Xue 2018 T2D instruments; each row a narrower subset of the one above. Variant counts in the table.")
```

```{r table-katp-specificity}
spec |>
  arrange(factor(dataset, levels = c(con_outcomes$dataset, comb_lab)), step) |>
  transmute(`AD dataset` = dataset, Step = step, Variants = n_snp, b, se,
            `OR (95% CI)` = or_ci(b, ci_lo, ci_hi), p = signif(p, 2)) |>
  save_table("katp_specificity")
```

### Instrument strength

R² for type 2 diabetes is converted from the observed case/control scale to the liability scale (Lee
et al. 2011). **The case/control counts and the 10% prevalence are unconfirmed** ([Open items](#open-items)).
F is scale-free.

```{r instrument-strength, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=3}
binary_exposures <- tibble::tibble(exposure = "t2d_xue", n_case = 62892, n_control = 596424, prevalence = 0.10)
liability_factor <- function(K, P) {
  z <- dnorm(qnorm(1 - K))
  K^2 * (1 - K)^2 / (z^2 * P * (1 - P))
}
strength_exposures <- unique(c("bmi_ukb", body_exposures, glyc_exposures))
strength <- res |>
  filter(exposure %in% strength_exposures, outcome == ad_outcome, arm == "raw", method == "IVW-MRE") |>
  left_join(binary_exposures, by = "exposure") |>
  mutate(R2_observed = R2,
         R2 = R2 * coalesce(liability_factor(prevalence, n_case / (n_case + n_control)), 1)) |>
  transmute(exposure, exposure_label = factor(short[exposure], levels = rev(short[strength_exposures])),
            n_snp, R2_pct = 100 * R2, R2_observed_pct = 100 * R2_observed, mean_F, total_F, N_exposure,
            binary = !is.na(prevalence))
save_source(strength)

strength |>
  pivot_longer(c(R2_pct, mean_F), names_to = "metric") |>
  mutate(metric = factor(c(R2_pct = "Variance explained, R² (%)", mean_F = "Mean F per instrument")[metric],
                         levels = c("Variance explained, R² (%)", "Mean F per instrument")),
         label = if_else(metric == "Mean F per instrument", sprintf("%.0f", value),
                         sprintf("%.1f%% (%d SNPs)", value, n_snp))) |>
  ggplot(aes(value, exposure_label)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey45", width = 0.65) +
  geom_vline(data = data.frame(metric = factor("Mean F per instrument"), x = 10),
             aes(xintercept = x), linetype = "dashed", colour = dark) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.9))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_ms
```

```{r table-instrument-strength}
strength |>
  arrange(desc(exposure_label)) |>
  transmute(Exposure = exposure_label, SNPs = n_snp, `GWAS N` = N_exposure, `R² (%)` = round(R2_pct, 2),
            `R² observed scale (%)` = if_else(binary, as.character(round(R2_observed_pct, 2)), "—"),
            `Mean F` = round(mean_F, 1), `Overall F` = round(total_F, 1)) |>
  save_table("instrument_strength_univariable")
step0 |>
  transmute(Set = set, SNPs = n_snp, `Mean F, fasting` = round(mean_F_fg, 1), `Mean F, 2 h` = round(mean_F_2h, 1),
            `Conditional F, fasting | 2 h` = round(cond_F_fg, 1), `Conditional F, 2 h | fasting` = round(cond_F_2h, 1),
            `Error correlation (fasting, 2 h)` = round(error_cor_fg_2h, 3), `Pre-specified analysis` = primary_analysis) |>
  save_table("instrument_strength_fg_2h", "Step 0 (outcome-blind). Conditional F < 10 for 2 h glucose in every set, so the contrast regression is primary.")
```

### Concordance across every method

Direction and whether the 95% interval excludes zero: the only comparison valid across scales
(MR-APSS, CAUSE and MRAID are SD per SD; the rest are log-OR per unit). Blank cells were not run.

```{r method-concordance, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
grid_methods <- c("IVW-MRE", "MR-PRESSO", "MR-RAPS", "MRBEE", "Weighted median", "Weighted mode",
                  "MR-Egger", "MR-APSS", "MR-APSS (p<5e-8)", "CAUSE", "MRAID")
grid_exposures <- unique(c(body_exposures, glyc_exposures))
calls <- c("Lower risk, interval excludes 0", "Lower risk, n.s.", "Higher risk, n.s.", "Higher risk, interval excludes 0")
conc <- res |>
  filter(exposure %in% grid_exposures, outcome == ad_outcome, method %in% grid_methods) |>
  mutate(excl = ci_lo * ci_hi > 0,
         call = factor(case_when(b < 0 & excl ~ calls[1], b < 0 ~ calls[2],
                                 b >= 0 & !excl ~ calls[3], TRUE ~ calls[4]), levels = calls),
         method = factor(method, levels = grid_methods),
         family = if_else(grepl("^SD", scale), "SD per SD", "log-OR per unit"),
         arm_label = factor(arm_labels[arm], levels = rev(arm_labels)),
         exposure_label = factor(short[exposure], levels = short[grid_exposures]))
save_source(conc |> select(exposure, outcome, arm, method, scale, b, ci_lo, ci_hi, p, call))

# Greyscale: fill = direction; a black frame and bold text = interval excludes 0.
conc <- conc |> mutate(direction = factor(if_else(b < 0, "Lower risk", "Higher risk"),
                                          levels = c("Lower risk", "Higher risk")))
ggplot(conc, aes(method, arm_label, fill = direction)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_tile(data = filter(conc, excl), fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.9, width = 0.9, height = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%+.2f", b), colour = direction, fontface = if_else(excl, "bold", "plain")),
            size = 2.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(exposure_label ~ family, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x", switch = "y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`Lower risk` = "grey35", `Higher risk` = "grey85"), drop = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`Lower risk` = "white", `Higher risk` = "black")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = NULL, caption = "Framed cells, bold values: 95% interval excludes 0.") +
  theme_ms +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1), strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1), panel.grid = element_blank())
```

## Supplementary: combined Uffelmann (all cohorts)

The most precise AD file, but it contains most of Bellenguez's cohorts, so it adds precision, not
independent evidence. Uncorrected: SlopeHunter is not identified for it.

```{r uffelmann-combined, fig.width=9, fig.height=9}
pa <- con |>
  filter(set %in% names(set_labels), outcome == comb_out, arm == comb_arm, scale == "per mmol/L",
         estimator %in% names(con_methods), term %in% names(term_labels)) |>
  mutate(set_label = factor(set_labels[set], levels = set_labels),
         term_label = factor(term_labels[term], levels = rev(term_labels)),
         method_label = factor(con_methods[estimator], levels = con_methods))
pb <- cl_pick(con_cl) |>
  filter(outcome == comb_out, arm == comb_arm, !group %in% c("other (small)", "Liver/lipid metabolism")) |>
  mutate(label = factor(sprintf("%s (%d)", group, n_snp)))
pb <- pb |> mutate(label = forcats::fct_reorder(label, b))
pc <- dt |> filter(outcome == comb_out, arm == comb_arm, trait == "AD (log-OR)", n_snp >= 3) |>
  mutate(label = forcats::fct_reorder(sprintf("%s (%d)", class, n_snp), b))
pd <- spec |> filter(outcome == comb_out) |> mutate(label = factor(step, levels = rev(spec_steps)))
save_source(pa |> select(set, step, estimator, term, b, se, p, n_snp), "fg-2h")
save_source(pb |> select(group, b, se, p, n_snp), "clusters")
save_source(pc |> select(target, class, b, se, p, n_snp), "drug-targets")
save_source(pd |> select(step, b, se, p, n_snp), "katp-specificity")

or_breaks <- c(0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1, 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.5, 1.75, 2)   # log-scale defaults drop the ticks above 1
simple_forest <- function(d, xlab, colour = ink) {
  ggplot(d, aes(x = exp(b), xmin = exp(b - 1.96 * se), xmax = exp(b + 1.96 * se), y = label)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
    geom_pointrange(colour = colour, size = 0.3) +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = or_breaks) + labs(x = xlab, y = NULL) + theme_ms
}
fa <- ggplot(pa, aes(x = exp(b), xmin = exp(b - 1.96 * se), xmax = exp(b + 1.96 * se), y = term_label,
                     colour = method_label, shape = method_label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ set_label, labeller = label_wrap_gen(30)) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = or_breaks) + scale_colour_manual(values = con_cols) + scale_shape_manual(values = con_shapes) +
  labs(x = "OR for AD per mmol/L (95% CI)", y = NULL, colour = NULL, shape = NULL) + theme_ms
fa / (simple_forest(pb, "OR per log-odds T2D, by cluster") | simple_forest(pc, "OR per log-odds T2D, by drug class")) /
  simple_forest(pd, "OR per log-odds T2D, KATP specificity steps") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A", caption = comb_lab)
```
